{{RaceIcon|HighElf|Male}}{{RaceIcon|HighElf|Female}} [[High elf]] | rulers = {{RaceIcon|HighElf|Male}} [[Dar'Khan Drathir]]''[[A Good Day]]'' | affiliation = [[Scourge]], [[Argent Dawn]], [[Silvermoon Remnant]], [[Illidari]] | minor = {{Alliance}} [[Shalandis Isle]] | loc = Northern [[Eastern Kingdoms]] | faffiliation = [[Alliance of Lordaeron]], Independent}} '''Eversong Wastes''' is an area located in the remote region of [[Quel'Thalas]], being the former home of the High Elves. It is currently ruled over by the traitor [[Dar'Khan Drathir]], who lords over the [[Scourge]] that have claimed the land after it was ravaged during the [[Third War]] at the hands of the Fallen Prince [[Arthas Menethil]]. In recent days, forces of the [[Alliance]] led by the [[Silvermoon Remnant]] have successfully claimed [[Shalandis Isle]] as a staging point, and the [[Argent Dawn]] maintains a few small camps throughout the region. The [[Illidari]] hold a small presence in the area, their motives unclear, and there are rumors of Quel'dorei resistance cells who have endured within Quel'Thalas ever since the fall. ==References== {{reflist}} {{Eastern Kingdoms}} [[Category:Eastern Kingdoms]] [[Category:Eversong Wastes]] [[Category:Quel'Thalas]] [[Category:Quel'Thalas (kingdom)]] [[Category:Woods]]
